name: claude-code-modified-by-nexalance
description: Codex-style prompt queue MANAGER for Anthropic's official Claude Code extension. Pure queue UI — no own chat. Pending prompts are auto-fed into your active Claude Code session via a Stop hook, so they only fire when the current turn is fully done.
author: Developer Jillur

commands.title: Fire the next pending prompt into Claude Code now
Probe macOS Accessibility (test or trigger the permission prompt)
Open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Automation

claudeCodeModified.autoOpenOnStartup.description: Automatically open the Claude Mod sidebar every time VS Code starts, so you never have to hunt for the icon. Turn off if you find it intrusive.

claudeCodeModified.autoKickWhenIdle.description: Experimental. When enabled, the extension auto-kicks pending prompts into Claude's chat via osascript when Claude appears idle. Off by default because the osascript paste path can miss the chat input or fail to submit, leading to silent drops. The reliable default flow is: the Stop hook drains the queue via decision:block+reason whenever Claude finishes a turn. Enable only if you've confirmed native submit works in your setup.

claudeCodeModified.enableNativeSubmit.description: Experimental. When enabled, the Stop hook tries to paste each queued prompt into Claude's chat via osascript so it appears as a real user message. When disabled (default), the hook uses decision:block+reason instead — the prompt appears under the 'Stop hook feedback:' label but reliably reaches Claude. Native submit looks nicer but can fail silently when Claude Code's webview doesn't honor a synthesized Enter key.
